title: Lead Software Engineer (AI & Integrations) | Remote, Full-Time
description:
About Us
PA Logistics Group and PA Transport run a freight brokerage, asset-based trucking, international forwarding and supply chain consulting business, with a focus on life sciences and pharma. We built our own TMS, and the business has outgrown it. We need one strong engineer to own our technology: rebuild the platform, connect it to how our operations actually run, and use AI to automate the manual work. We're on a mission to build a $200 million logistics company, and the system you build is what we'll run on to get there.

What You'll Do
Keep the current CodeIgniter/Laravel system running while you lead the rebuild in NestJS, Next.js and PostgreSQL
Build and maintain integrations: carrier onboarding, GPS tracking, banking APIs, customer and carrier portals
Ship AI features that do real work, like document extraction and verification, using LLM APIs and tools like n8n
Own security day to day: access control, secrets, backups, logging, patching
Decide the architecture yourself and document it so nothing lives only in your head
Help hire and lead the second engineer as the team grows

Who Should Apply
We're looking for an A player. You've got 6+ years of full-stack experience, with production work in PHP/Laravel and Node/TypeScript. You've built LLM integrations in production, not just tutorials. You have solid security habits, experience with AWS or GCP, strong written English, and you write things down. Logistics or freight tech experience is a big plus.
This isn't a ticket queue on a big team. You'll be our first in-house engineer, in the room for the big decisions, and you'll see what your work does to the business every week. If you've wanted to build something from the ground up and grow with it, this is it.

Schedule and Compensation
Full-time, long-term (individual engineers only, no agencies)
40+ hours weekly
At least 4 hours daily overlap with US Pacific time
Reliable power backup (UPS) and backup internet required
Retention bonuses at 6 and 12 months
Paid take-home project as part of the interview process

How to Apply
Your GitHub or work samples
One paragraph on the hardest integration you've built
A 60 to 90 second audio intro (voice note or MP3, no video) attached to your proposal, covering:

Who you are and what you've built in the last 2 years
One AI integration you shipped to production and what broke along the way
Why you want to own a system yourself instead of working as one dev on a big team
